references.title: ZEN approved restrained high-impact visual-language reference
observations: Clear visual hierarchy and center focus
Large usable dynamic range with preserved intensity and density headroom
Restrained beam/mover presence rather than constant full usage
Depth and layering support a clean deliberate composition
Impact is created partly by contrast with restrained surrounding states
Variation can come from density, intensity, position, layer, beam presence, and movement rather than constant color switching
Sparse states can still feel visually complete
Composition reads as clean, deliberate, and powerful
non_transferable_specifics: Exact fixture types are not universal
Exact fixture placement is not universal
Exact cue timing is not universal
Exact beam count is not universal
